name: medical-outcomes-explorer
description: Healthcare intelligence platform providing CMS hospital quality measures and FDA medical device post-market surveillance.

tools.name: get_hospital_quality
tools.description: Retrieves clinical quality measures, mortality, HRRP readmission penalty ratios, and infection SIRs for a US hospital.

tools.name: get_device_surveillance
tools.description: Retrieves 510(k) clearances, MAUDE adverse events, and recall classifications for an FDA medical device product code.

productCode.description: FDA 3-letter product code (e.g. FRN, NIQ, NVN)
